Question: Please suggest which name can I keep for my son Aliyan, Abdan, Fehmaan, Sharhaan and Zakwan? Suppose the name is not correct tell me the reason and meaning? If all the names are correct then tell me which one is the best name with meaning. Answer ID: 146584 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 197/203/SN=3/1438) Sharhaan and Fehmaan are not Arabic words. Also such names were not found in the era of the Prophet (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) and the Sahabah; hence both these names are not suitable. However, you may keep any name among Aliyan, Abdan and Zakwan. However the best one among them is Zakwan and Abdan. Both have good meaning i.e. ‘sensible and ‘worshipper’. Zakwan had been the name of several Sahabah – may Allah be pleased with them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
